findings.body: The approval check hashes the document on origin/main or story/<key>, but `_brief` reads the task checkout's working copy (worker.py:183). Editing "What changes for you" or "Done when" in that checkout therefore passes this check while sending unapproved instructions to Codex and recording a status commit. Conversely, re-approving the story branch can start a conversation under the new approval while still sending the task checkout's old brief. Validate the actual brief's approved sections against the current approval before committing status.
findings.title: Not done: 8. Validate approval against the story text sent to the worker

findings.body: Every `JsonRpcError` is treated as proof that the conversation is absent. A server error while reading an existing conversation therefore emits `read: null`; `recover` then logs the unfinished turn as "lost" and permits another turn (codex.py:170–177). A failed read does not establish that Codex reports no turn or that the previous turn stopped. Only a confirmed missing conversation/turn should produce null; other read failures must preserve the unfinished record and refuse.
findings.title: Not done: 9. Refuse recovery when reading the conversation fails
